# `alignment` package: architecture note excerpt

Full note: `knowledge/architecture/alignment.md`; update it in the same change (skill `notes`).

## Responsibility

- Turn a transcript and its speech into one time segment per token, so audio segments can become players.
- The `sgpa_segments` partition turns segments into players. No backend and no audio rendering (that is masking (`knowledge/architecture/masking.md`)); the `audio` extra (`librosa`, `soundfile`) plus the `transformers` extra for the default model.

## Invariants

- Adjacent segments share one boundary, which lies inside the gap between their character spans.
- A token without a character in the model vocabulary gets no segment; a transcript with none raises `ValueError`.
- Segments last at least `MIN_DURATION_S` (0.05 s) and have `end_sample > start_sample`.
- The aligner changes no global state (warnings filters, library log levels).

## Known issues

- No backend generates from audio yet (D02 - Audio backend (`knowledge/issues/D02 - Audio backend.md`)); runs score the masked transcripts.
